name: Virginia Quiet Championship 2025
information:
This is the Virginia Quiet Championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaQuietChampionship2025#61644-championship-eligibility) tab.
